user.title: Intentsity
user.description: Adds a sidebar panel for labeling wake-word clips and correcting Assist conversations. Audio capture settings can be changed later under Configure.

init.title: Audio capture
init.description: Devices can send PCM audio over UDP or MQTT. Wake detections arrive on the webhook shown in the panel, or on the MQTT event topic.

data.retention_days: Delete clips after (days, 0 to keep forever)

data_description.udp_assistant_id: Used only for legacy datagrams that carry no assistant ID. Leave blank to fall back to "default".
data_description.sample_rate: Fallback for senders that do not declare their format. WWD2 packets and audio_info messages override this.
data_description.mqtt_audio_topic: A single-level + wildcard marks the segment holding the assistant ID.
data_description.retention_days: Pruning runs twice a day and removes the clip row, WAV, and metadata file.
